source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D1-英文原版
text: Alex M. I'm 25 years old, I've been playing games since I was very young. I mean, I spend most of my day playing games right now, I don't work anyway, I don't have any job, and I just play games right now.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D1-英文原版
text: Not at the moment, I was participating in tournaments for a while, I was participating in Warzone tournaments last year, but I do not have such an income at the moment.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D1-英文原版
text: The first game I started was Counter, I played a lot of CS go. Afterwards, the COD Warzone game came out, battle royale, I played PUBG before, but Warzone caught my attention much more, I can say that Warzone is the game I have played the most in the last 2 years. Then I started playing Cycle. The Cycle is a Looter and Shooter game, it's the first time I've played a game in that category, I played it very fondly, and I’ve played it for about 1050 hours. Afterwards, a lot of cheating started to be made in the game, this situation alienated me from the game, and there were already too many player losses. I tried to talk to many admins about this situation, I explained my problems, I wanted to help, I said; I can take part in team if necessary, let's alleviate this problem a little bit or solve it. Since the admins were not willing to find a solution, I left the game, I only played it occasionally. Then I came across Dank and Darker's alpha playtest 2, I played it, it's my favorite game right now, there will be another one-week test on February 6th. I'm waiting for it.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D1-英文原版
text: Yes, because I'm talented in this style, that's why I usually play.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D1-英文原版
text: I mean, I think I'm in the top one percent of good players in the world.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D1-英文原版
text: I have an aggressive playing style.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D1-英文原版
text: I mean, we already play most of the games as a team.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D1-英文原版
text: Usually I am the Leader, I am the one who directs.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D1-英文原版
text: Of course, I'm competitive, it's nice to have a rank system in games, but this is not possible in looter and shooter games, but in other games I play Warzone or CS go, I always play competitively, so I enjoy it, getting up in the rankings motivates people in games. In looter and shooter, you can get achievements by keeping the statistics high or by killing a bosses etc. There are leaders in dark and darker, like the ones with the highest kills, I'm trying to be good at them as well.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D1-英文原版
text: It's not quite right for me to say this, but I think I'm very good.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D1-英文原版
text: I don't play mobile games. I only played Mobile Legends, it was a LoL-like game, moba game, I reached the highest ranks in it, but I did not play much, I played max 1000 1500 matches. Before Pubgm, there was a game called Rules of Survival, it was an old battle royale game, now I don't play mobile games, I mostly play computer games.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D1-英文原版
text: I mean, I check the new games, but I couldn't see anything new, frankly, I didn't find anything interesting.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D1-英文原版
text: You know, I look at Steam sometimes, but I mean, I think it's hard to find something that will be released there, if any content creator from YouTube shares it, that’s how I find it or I find the games with a friend's recommendation. There is no platform that I follow 100% for new games. Here's what usually happens: a game is coming out or about to be released, a streamer I like on Twitch plays it, if I like the game, I play it.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D1-英文原版
text: Gameplay is very important, for example, there are some games, and you can't give your skill in the game because the game optimization may be bad, which causes FPS problems. Especially it is very important that the optimization is good and there is no cheating.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D1-英文原版
text: For example, I played Cycle for 1050 hours, now there was a period when the cheats were at their peak, at that time I was fed up with the cheats. Cheating is very bad, especially in looter and shooter games, it takes a lot of time to play, and I enjoyed it very much. I work so hard, I win weapons, for example, I play 10 games to win an item, and cheaters take it away from me in one game. This situation destroys my motivation to play, this is exactly what happened to me. You know, globally, hour based, I was one of the people who played Cycle the most. This situation destroyed my desire to play, my inventory is still very full at the moment, but I don't feel like playing it anymore because I know what I will encounter if I enter the game.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D1-英文原版
text: Escape From Tarkov, I know this game, I’ve never played it but I’ve seen people play, it is an old game. Hunt: Showdown, I played it for a while around 100 hours not much. The Cycle, I know a lot about this game, I played for a long time, I started playing about 2 weeks after the first game was released. Marauders, I was playing Cycle when Marauders came out, my friends invited me to play but I didn't like it very much, I didn't want to play because I already played Cycle. I don't know anything about Vigor and Zero. Dark and Darker, I admire Dark and Darker right now, I want to start playing the game as soon as a week passes. Hell is others, I don’t know this one. Warzone 2.0 DMZ, I don't think it's a very good game, I already play Warzone. DMZ is made as a looter and shooter game, but I think it is not a very good game. Battlefield 2042 Hazard zone, I know about Battlefield but I’ve never heard Hazard zone. I don’t know anything about mobile ones.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D1-英文原版
text: I don't understand exactly what you mean, these are the games that I really enjoy. I don't like moba games, I don't play LOL etc. Let's just say that, I like shooting.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D1-英文原版
text: In Looter and Shooter, you can get an external inventory on the screen, there is no such thing in Shooter games, you enter, you die or you are killed.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D1-英文原版
text: It varies from person to person.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D1-英文原版
text: It's a good thing for me, I really like this genre after Cycle. Now I've started playing Dark and Darker, I'm looking forward for the game, so it's a good thing for me. I think we need to distinguish between the two genres, I was enjoying playing CS go a lot. I played that game for 3000 hours, my skills come from that game. I have a lot of fun in both genres, but now my choice is Dark and Darker.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D1-英文原版
text: Yes, I liked it a lot, especially after Cycle.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D1-英文原版
text: In Dark and Darker, aim may be important, but you have to shoot people in Cycle or Cod. These are FPS games, using a gun, killing people, things are similar in both game genres. There are more primitive weapons in Dark and Darker, such as archer, ranger, and aim is more important, in this case strategy can be a little more important.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D1-英文原版
text: I know that is a looter and shooter game, there is a wipe every few months, and the progress is reset. As I watched Tarkov on Twitch, I didn't think to start it because its image was a bit tiring for me. Cycle is free but Tarkov is very expensive. Whoever I talk to tells me that there are cheats in the game, which drives me away. But I mean, it looks fun in terms of gameplay, it's pretty realistic. But it's not good for a game to be very realistic, it makes me tired, being too realistic does make the game unplayable, for example, when you get hit, you will stop the bleeding, you will get injections, I don't think a game is very good when the game goes into too much detail.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D1-英文原版
text: First of all, it is very important for me that there are no cheats, I do not like “pay to win” in games. Pay to win is not very common in these games, anyway. Also, gameplay is very important to me. For example, think of a game where you can get 200 fps with very good optimization, and another game where I can get 100 fps, but I like the game too much. Cycle was like the second, sometimes I even got 60 fps, although I played for 1000 hours, the reason I quit was not fps, it was cheating.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D1-英文原版
text: Yes. Normally, the game ends, you get rid of the cheater, but when I see cheaters in Looter and Shooter, I wonder if I will see the cheater again in the next game, will he steal my items? This puts me in a bad mood.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D1-英文原版
text: Bad of course, this mood.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D1-英文原版
text: No, I don't think there's anything a cheater can add to a game.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D1-英文原版
text: I know that game, I haven't played it, but I think it was something like a simulation game, I think Tarkov is more fun, but it would be silly for me to comment without playing it.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D1-英文原版
text: I met one of my current playmates during the Cycle period. I am continuing Dark and darker with that friend, we have already played it with great pleasure, we are waiting together. But not all of our friends necessarily prefer the same games. Many of my friends did not play the game with me when I started playing Cycle, I started it alone.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D1-英文原版
text: I mean, I've heard the same thing from a few of them, the image has an incredible sharpness while watching it like this, it's probably related to the settings of the players to get a better view in the game, but it was tiring for me, but since I know that if I start playing the game, I have to adjust the settings that way, I didn't think to start.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D1-英文原版
text: If it's something original, it's a bonus, yes.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D1-英文原版
text: Yes I’ve played it for 200 hours, test times were already around 300 hours in total. My favorite is Dark and Darker. This may change in 1 years from now…

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D1-英文原版
text: In that game, there is a thing like reaching the maximum. In other words, there is always a little more than what you achieve, and you can lose what you have while doing it. All in all, I think it's a pretty immersive game. Apart from that, we are playing test versions now, the game is a difficult game, and there is a constant struggle where it is not possible to just wonder around. People look at the game and say that the textures are bad, I find it wrong to make such comments on a game that is in the testing phase. They criticize the quality...

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D1-英文原版
text: It always meets my expectations, always adding something new to it, I mean game is in alpha testing stage, not even in beta. In terms of gameplay, there are minor problems with FPS, but since it is a game that does not require us to shoot constantly, the FPS problem is bearable. If I had a gun in my hand, if I were shooting, I would like to get 200 fps, but you use swords and arrows in the game, so the fps problem is not very critical. I think, this problem will be fixed once the testing phase is over.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D1-英文原版
text: I played Dark and Darker for 200 hours, but the game was already 300 hours accessible in total. I slept, woke up and played this game.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D1-英文原版
text: No, you misunderstood, I played 200 hours, and the total game accessible time was 300 hours.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D1-英文原版
text: For example, I wake up and play until I fall asleep. Sometimes I even played for 16 hours. It depended on my energy that day.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D1-英文原版
text: I played with my friends. It's not a game you can play alone.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D1-英文原版
text: I have a friend, we met at Cycle and we discovered this game one night. We were playing with him all the time, but the 3rd person was always changing, we were playing with new people.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D1-英文原版
text: 10. It is my favorite game.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D1-英文原版
text: Dark and darker is the game that keeps me alive while playing. It's hard to play a game for 20 hours and I've played it for over 24 hours. If you don't feel sleepy while playing a game, that's a good thing. The game is very enjoyable that's why I gave it 10.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D1-英文原版
text: I gained all my fps gaming skills thanks to CS, I was playing the game even when I was a kid, and CS gave me all my gaming skills. Compared to Valorant, I can't say that I like Valorant very much. I've played Valorant for 50-100 hours in total, and I haven't even spent time on the game. The games in the logic of 5 vs 5 are good for me, but apart from CS go, there is also Rainbow, I didn't like it either, my favorite in this genre is Cs go and it has a basic gameplay. There is nothing too difficult, you just have to learn how to use a smoke bomb etc.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D1-英文原版
text: I played Warzone a lot in the first period, and I had success in tournaments. There was a tournament organized by Gamify, where I came first. Besides, I was playing very well, especially in Warzone 1, I made friends while playing and I'm still seeing each other. Now warzone 2 is out, this version is a bit more like a mix of PUBG and Warzone 1. Warzone 1 had movement options such as running and sliding. It required constant movement. Warzone 2 is a more strategic and calm version. I liked Warzone 2 more than Warzone 1. It has some problems now but it will be fixed with updates. Warzone 1 has also had a lot of cheats lately.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D1-英文原版
text: Because I am very angry with Cycle. Cycle was 10 for me, I loved playing it. I was always recording when I saw cheating. They were cheaters that I can present as direct evidence. There was a forum where we could post cheat clips, I was sending the clip there, but there was a bad system and I didn't know when the man got banned or not. I also told them, that the number of players are low, you should ban the cheaters immediately if you can’t make that happen I can work for you for free and ban them. I got answers like we don't work this way. When I asked if they were planning to close the game, they said they had no such plans and they said that the course of the game was good, they made fun of me.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D1-英文原版
text: I think it's the immersiveness of the game.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D1-英文原版
text: There is no such thing as reaching the highest, it is difficult to reach high even in statistics, there are items that can be developed, and it is also difficult to develop them. It takes a lot of time to develop items. When you lose while doing these, you have to start over and it is quite immersive to do them. The items you can get from the person you kill are quite exciting. The bosses are also very excited. I come from MMORPG a bit. It's like a mix of MMORPG and shooter game in these games. Looter and shooter games are a bit like MMORPGs. In general, I can explain immersiveness like this.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D1-英文原版
text: I have videos that will actually explain it.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D1-英文原版
text: My brother, me and my friend, we all have the same character, we all have a crossbow, normally all rangers use bows, but we used crossbows, and every time we came across someone we killed and continued. It's very enjoyable and we did it in the last 2 days. We are planning to do it again on February 6, even killing a man is quite fun.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D1-英文原版
text: Crossbow is a weapon that goes to the point you aim more stable, so you can't shoot continuously, you need to reload it. The man shot by two people at the same time dies anyway, so even the reactions of the other party are funny. If we can talk to the other party in the game, if we can chat with the other party in the game, a lot of funny things would happen in the game, maybe they will bring this feature, I don't know.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D1-英文原版
text: Let me give an example from the bow, when you stretch the bow and throw it... in the games, the bullet hits a little lower than where I aim at long distances, and goes to where I aim at close distances. In this game, we need to learn where the bullet will go. It’s pretty fun to do that. For example, when you shoot a man with a sniper in Cs go, if you aim at the man, the bullet reaches the man. But shooting a man from 1000 meters in battlefield is much more enjoyable. In this case, it is also necessary to understand the effect of wind and distance on the bullet. Here, too, it is very difficult to shoot a distant man with an arrow and it is very enjoyable to achieve this.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D1-英文原版
text: When I first started Cs go, my computer was very bad, of course I was trying to rank up, but I was playing with low FPS. After I changed my computer, my game performance changed, then I have friends who play well. When the cheats started to increase, I started playing the game via FACEIT. It went on like this for a while. Then I quit the game and started playing Warzone. In Warzone, when the game first came out, newcomers die very simply because there was no rank system in the game. Afterwards, my performance improved and my opponents learned to play and my gaming experience improved. Beginners develop themselves more easily, for example, if your game skill is 10, it is difficult to make 11, but 1 to 5 is easy. In this case, as time passes, the game becomes more difficult.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D1-英文原版
text: It's motivating, of course, killing bots gets boring after a while. After all, it's a competitive game and it's more fun to play against good players.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D1-英文原版
text: Updates in the game can sometimes motivate me and sometimes demotivate me. For example, the period when the first map was in Warzone 1 was good, there were deficiencies, but these were gradually corrected, then new features began to come to the map, such as explosions, and the game started to drop 10 fps to 20 fps with each update. These demotivated me. Then a new map called Caldera came to the game and this caused me to quit the game. The map was very bad in my opinion and I quit the game. Then I started Cycle. Cheats on Cycle demotivated me. To prevent cheats, 3 maps were added to the game, a task was requested from the players to enter the 3rd map, it was more difficult to come across a cheater on the map since it was necessary to spend time in game to enter, which motivated me. Despite everything, when I talked to the admins, I was getting demotivated.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D1-英文原版
text: Worst of all, there was a server problem during the last test process, and my connection to the game was suddenly gone. Even though I reconnected, all my items were disappearing. Once, my inventory was back as if I hadn't played for 2-3 hours. So the game took away what I earned in 2-3 hours. But I can't judge the game for such problems because it's still in testing phase.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D1-英文原版
text: I can quit the game if it's a constant problem, but I don't think that will happen. I trust the dark and darker developers.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D1-英文原版
text: Things like this have to happen in the testing phases so they don't happen when the game is released.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D1-英文原版
text: Yes, I can quit the game if it happens all the time, this is the case when I came across cheaters, if I come across cheaters once or twice, I can tolerate it, but if it happens constantly, I either have to quit the game or buy cheats.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D1-英文原版
text: Compared to Cycle, there are creatures in both games, but the creatures in Cycle are a bit easier. In Dark and Darker, however well you know the game and the creatures, the creatures sometimes put you in such a difficult situation that you die. There were very few situations in Cycle that I couldn't get out of, Dark and Darker are much more difficult if we compare the creatures. There are bosses in the same way in Dark and Darker, they are also very difficult, and for example, there was no boss in Cycle that I could not kill on my own. I only came across a cheater once in Dark and Darker.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D1-英文原版
text: In normal PVP games, there is only killing and ranking, there is no in-game development or character development in these games, there is no extraction. I think these games are attractive to people who played MMO RPGs, because you can strengthen the character in MMO RPGs, and in looter and shooter games, we can develop the character as we play, with the items we extracted. This creates an immersive game experience.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D1-英文原版
text: Yes, it is very important how much we improve ourselves here. In the other genre, it is very important what our ranking is, nothing else.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D1-英文原版
text: What if they have a lot of potential in shooting... If the players who play high-intensity shooter games are interested in it, I think their potential is very high, but a very good Looter and Shooter player cannot be very successful in the Shooter game.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D1-英文原版
text: Because you always have to be very good in a normal PVP game, but Looter and Shooter you can also spend a lot of chill time, or it can become a model that you can only do strategy and play as PVE, So you are not constantly in competition, actually, but in PVP games, you're only competitive, so if a player moves from PVP to PVPVE player will be successful, but a player who only plays Looter and Shooter is less likely to be successful when they switch to Shooter. Again, of course, there are a lot of talented players, but I think the probability of the other is higher.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D1-英文原版
text: In any FPS game, reaction time is much more critical, you can play looter and shooter more comfortably. You can play step by step by examining it. The game is more difficult as there is direct competition in a normal FPS game. If you fight for 5 minutes in looter and shooter, you can run for 5 minutes. But in the other you run for 5 minutes but fight for 30 minutes.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D1-英文原版
text: I started this genre with Cycle and now I continue with Dark and Darker and I can say this gives me a lot of pleasure. But maybe because I like this MMO, it's fun to upgrade a character and combine it with my shooter skills.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D1-英文原版
text: There must be progress, after all, they are setting targets or you have to do a task to open a map, etc. These are immersive factors.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D1-英文原版
text: In Cycle, I first learned about the creatures, then I needed more powerful weapons and did the tasks. If you're a good player, these don't take longer than two days. After that, the only purpose of the game turns into PVP.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D1-英文原版
text: It's getting ordinary, yes, we know what to do after wipe, and it’s always the same thing. When I played Cycle in the first season, I was mostly playing PVE, first I was developing my inventory. When the new season came, I finished the missions and started doing PVP, I played war-oriented.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D1-英文原版
text: I think no. Dark and darker is not like Cycle, you can't stay on the map you enter forever, the duration of Dark and Darker maps are around 13-14 minutes, just like a mix of battle royale and looter and shooter.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D1-英文原版
text: Yes for Dark and Darker. It is economical because if the items do not disappear, there will be items everywhere, but the fact that the players have to die causes the items to be lost and contribute to the game. This may be a bad for a player but it is a good thing for a game.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D1-英文原版
text: No, it changes from game to game, this is what I am trying to say, you are free in Cycle, but you are not here. In a normal battle royale game, the zone slowly closes, you either win or die. There is time limitation in FPS. The concept of freedom varies from game to game.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D1-英文原版
text: Yes exactly. If I need to give another example as freedom, you can open a parachute when you jump from a high place in DMZ or Warzone, this adds freedom to the game. If I jump in the cycle, I will die. I can jump from anywhere in Dark and Darker without dying. I think it's a freedom.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D1-英文原版
text: Rainbow has features such as drilling walls or breaking doors, but there are no such features in CS go, for example. Of course, I didn't play this game, I played it for 10 hours in total, but I have mastered the game. You can break the wall by placing a bomb on the wall. I think it is a freedom. I saw it in a tournament, when the game started, the players were creating a different base for themselves by blowing up the walls. This is also a strategic situation, I think.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D1-英文原版
text: I don't think it's a good thing. A game should stay as a game. I don't like it when it gets very close to reality and turns the game into a simulation. He can go and fight in real life if he wants to play something very realistic.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D1-英文原版
text: Being able to do something like this is very enjoyable, but doing it all the time can get tiring. In Dark and Darker, I shoot people with arrows, but I don't really get tired while shooting arrows or I don't try too hard while recovering my health. It might be fun if just a few things are close to the truth, but...

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D1-英文原版
text: Yes, Escape from Tarkov is very close to a simulation in my opinion, For example my leg is broken, I need to treat it and I don't want to deal with it in the middle of the war. It seems tiring to me. Some people may enjoy it a lot, but I don't think it appeals to the general public, so I think that the basic games make it more attractive. So the game creates an audience, of course, some players love and play, but their player number remains 100, but if they make a more average game, maybe their number of players will be 1000. Most of all, I think it is not good to be realistic. It can be played, but not all the time.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D1-英文原版
text: Yes. Because extreme realism causes high graphics, it is tiring on the computer, and it is very difficult to find a computer of this style in Turkey standards.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D1-英文原版
text: I think immersion is very important in the long run, what did you say at first?

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D1-英文原版
text: This is an advantage for a game if there are enough players…

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D1-英文原版
text: I think extreme realism is very tiring, but I find the in-game progressions very enjoyable…

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D1-英文原版
text: Aiming and optimizing with weapons is more important to me if I don't feel good playing the game, I don't play.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D1-英文原版
text: Are you talking about incredibly difficult shots or are you talking about playing the game, it is more important for me that the gameplay is basic. It is very important for me that the bullet goes to the right place when I shoot, and I want to be able to show my skills when I am playing. It is very important for me to develop characters and weapons, in looter and shooter. Bosses very pleasant to kill, if I put them in the first and second place...

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D1-英文原版
text: I like science fiction, but I don't like extreme fantasy elements.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D1-英文原版
text: There may be magic in a game, but it's annoying that everything is done with skills like in Valorant, but the wizard in Dark and Darker doesn't bother me because the game is already set in ancient times. In games set in the past, some fantasy elements are nice, but I find the combination of modern weapons and fantasy elements ridiculous.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D1-英文原版
text: It should be fair, not pay to win, anti-cheat system should be good. Even if there is cheating in the game, quick action should be taken or cheater must be punished quickly I am against free games, the number of players in free games is high, yes, but the large number of players also causes the number of cheaters. When a game is paid and a cheater is banned, they will have to buy the game again, which I think is an obstacle for cheaters. I also like that there are shooter elements in the games, since I consider myself talented in shooters, its existence is important for me. My ideal game doesn't have to be looter. Dark and Darker Looter and Shooter, the game I've been waiting for right now. I think the ideal game is Dark and Darker. It doesn't contain too many shooter elements, not like a classic looter game. You can also play as Looter. It's very enjoyable to play. For me it is close to ideal. It's a pretty immersive game. The only problem is that it is very difficult to play the game alone right now, even if you know the game very well, it is very difficult to play alone, but this will be fixed as it is a testing phase.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D1-英文原版
text: I think they will show us the first map during the next test. The game consists of 3 stages and we have played 2 and 3 so far. I think there will be 1 map on February 6, we were told the map would be easier. I think people who want to play alone can use the 1st map.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D1-英文原版
text: Yes, during this testing period, the map will attract players who doesn’t have friends and the number of players will be higher.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D1-英文原版
text: I dream of a game that both an MMORPG and a shooter at the same time. I want it to be a game where I can both shoot and improve myself. Looter and Shooter games look like my dream game but not exactly. You have a chance to lose in looter and shooters and there is a wipe. You continue to progress in MMORPGs. This is my dream but I don't think it will come true.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D1-英文原版
text: I think there are a lot of cons, the aiming ability of a person playing MMORPG is not very good anyway, if we put a shooter in it, the players may not like it, it's just in my imagination.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D1-英文原版
text: I would spend a lot of time in a game like this. The pros are; I love MMORPG games. Upgrading is mechanism is very good for me, and if we combine it with fps games, that is, shooter, it will be good for me as I can show my talent. I think my dream game is not a game that will appeal to the general public. By the way, what exactly is the purpose of this study and what are you trying to learn? What will you do with this information afterwards, I can make a logic based on that.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D1-英文原版
text: Is this about making a new game?

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D1-英文原版
text: I find some skins overwhelming, sometimes they make such a skin that the game turns to pay-to-win. It is very difficult to see or identify the person who has that skin. It does look smaller. It's bad that this happens, but it happens in every game, the game developer has to make money and they earn money from it. I love the battle pass, it's nice to get things that come season by season. If you are playing the game, once you buy a pass, you can use it continuously. I think this feature is nice.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D1-英文原版
text: Usually in games it is forbidden to directly trade with someone, it is very difficult to evolve into something... it is very difficult to create a market for it, something is not infinite in quantity, its value is not lost...

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D1-英文原版
text: Are you talking about real money or...

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D1-英文原版
text: Money should be earned by playing, not pay to win. Pay to win usually wins games. Developers can earn money from such games, but they cannot gain new players. When you start a game you should not lose because you have no money.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D1-英文原版
text: There may be skins etc., but it shouldn't affect gameplay.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D1-英文原版
text: I think it is unreasonable in the long run, I personally did not buy such a thing, the possibilities are clear what will come out of it, and this is a situation where you will not gain anything in the long run. If you are lucky, maybe you can win, but I opened a case in CS go without buying it, but by winning in-game, I have not won anything. If you're lucky, you might win out of the blue, but usually you don't.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D1-英文原版
text: If it contains just skins, I think it's ridiculous, if there will be Pubg like an in-game market logic, then it can be a box, I like the store in warzone more, a new product comes, if you like it, you buy it, if you don't, you don't. When I get the box, I don't know if anything good will come out of it. When Pubg first came out, the items that came out of that box are very valuable because it was very rare and people were selling it. Skin is not a big deal in my opinion.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D1-英文原版
text: Yes. Especially not in a competitive game.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D1-英文原版
text: Something tradable or bought with money?

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D1-英文原版
text: Did I buy this box with money?

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D1-英文原版
text: This is pay to win. If you have enough money, you will eventually buy that gun.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D1-英文原版
text: They were for skins, not guns.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D1-英文原版
text: Yes, There are also examples of this, Point black for example, this is a pay to win game. Even in professional arenas, everyone needs to have those items. If you are a normal player, you need 4 5 bullets to kill, but you can be killed with 1 bullet. I didn't play these games much, there were no such things in CS go, this way is better for me.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D1-英文原版
text: For example, in Dark and Darker, seeing the damage increase as you develop a character and being more successful in situations where you had difficulty before makes the game gripping. For example, in order to kill a boss, it is necessary to reach a certain level.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D1-英文原版
text: In general, playing a strategy game with 2 or 3 friends is very enjoyable. For example, it gives me pleasure to focus on weapon choices and killing.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D1-英文原版
text: It's very simple, because the game wasn't good, I think the developers couldn't manage to make the game.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D1-英文原版
text: First of all, it is a very contrary game to the logic of looter and shooter, there is a Shooter part, but there is no Looter part. In Looter and shooter, I expect in-game items and character developments etc. There is no such thing in DMZ. Can't even extract a bag. In every game, you need to win something from 0.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D1-英文原版
text: Yes, the game is closer to battle royale. There is also the closure of the area, in the looters and shooters I played, there was no area closure in Cycle. There is in Dark and Darker, but there are nice details in the self-development part. But there is no self-development part in Dmz, there are tasks and the task chains are very bad, after a task requested from us, they are asked again with higher numbers, it is ridiculous. I think that's why Dmz is not good. The game does not appeal to people who already play warzone. The game appeals to those who play Looter and Shooter, but when the player starts playing, he cannot find what he is looking for.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D1-英文原版
text: I've played Warframe, I've played Destiny very little, I don't like going into a room and doing quests and repeating them all the time. It's always the same room, the same scenario, and I don't like it. Warframe also had pay to win.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D1-英文原版
text: Yes. I couldn't like the logic of this game. The same goes for Wow, there is a large player base when we look at it, but I am not interested in doing the same thing all the time. I've played these before but I didn't like them very much. If I'm not mistaken, there was pay to win.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D1-英文原版
text: If I have to make a criticism, if they are thinking of making a game with these questions, I think the questions are very bad, if these people are game makers.
